chapters.label: The final, live
chapters.text: Enschede, 2017. The Euro final: the Netherlands against Denmark. A long ball goes down the right. Pernille Harder races after it, cuts into the box... and scores!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Harder starts in her own half, so she’s not offside. The defenders raise their arms, but play goes on. She keeps the ball close.

chapters.label: Near post
chapters.text: Behind the goal now. A quick left-foot shot, low at the near post. The keeper goes the wrong way!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball close as you run, then shoot before the defender recovers!
